en.name: VirtuBand: Music Studio
en.title: VirtuBand — Music Studio
en.subtitle: Play, record & compose
en.short_description: Play virtual instruments, record multi-track songs, and compose with AI help.
en.description:
VirtuBand is a music studio that fits in your pocket. Play virtual instruments with your fingers, layer them into multi-track recordings, and get an AI suggestion when you cannot find the next part.

—— Play ——

A library of virtual instruments — keys, strings, drums and more — each with its own playable interface rather than one generic keyboard. Open an instrument to see its detail view, tune it, and play.

—— Record ——

STUDIO
A multi-track workspace. Lay down a part, then another over it, and build a song a track at a time.

TRACKS AND RECORDINGS
Everything you record is saved to your library, where you can rename, replay, and organise it.

—— Compose ——

AI COMPOSE
Describe what you want, or hand it what you have, and get a suggested part back. Useful when a song stalls halfway.

JAM
A looser space for playing along and improvising without setting up a full project.

—— Built to get out of your way ——

• Dashboard showing your recent work
• Dark interface designed for playing in low light
• Sign-in is optional — tap "Continue as Guest" and every feature is available
• Works offline; nothing you record needs a network to save

—— Optional Premium ——

A Premium tier is available. The free app is fully usable without it.

en.release_notes:
First release of VirtuBand.

• A library of virtual instruments, each with its own playable interface
• Multi-track Studio for layering a song a part at a time
• Recordings library with rename and replay
• AI Compose for a suggested part when a song stalls
• Jam mode for loose improvisation
• Works offline; sign-in is optional via "Continue as Guest"

Feedback is welcome at contact@safecodeg.com.

review_information.notes:
Thanks for reviewing VirtuBand.

VirtuBand is a virtual music studio: playable instruments, multi-track recording, and an AI compose helper. Sign-in is OPTIONAL and gates no features - on the login screen tap "Continue as Guest" and everything is available. No demo account is needed.

Test instructions:
1. Launch the app and step through onboarding.
2. On the login screen tap "Continue as Guest". This is the intended review path - no account is required and no feature is gated behind sign-in.
3. Open Instruments and tap any instrument to open its detail view, then play it by touch. Audio needs a physical device; a simulator may render the UI silently.
4. Open Studio and record a short part, then add a second track over it.
5. Open Recordings to replay and rename what you just recorded.
6. Open AI Compose and request a suggested part.
7. Open Premium from Settings to view the paywall.
8. Settings - Account also offers sign-in for a guest who wants it later; it remains optional.

Privacy:
• Data collected: The audio you record and the projects you create, held on your device. Sign-in is optional; if you use it, your email is held by our authentication provider.
• Network: None required to play or record. Network is used only for optional sign-in and for AI Compose requests you initiate.
• Location: Not requested and not used.
• Tracking: None. The app does not read the advertising identifier and shows no App Tracking Transparency prompt. Anonymous aggregate usage events (such as which instruments are opened) may be collected; they contain nothing identifying.

If you need anything else, please email contact@safecodeg.com and we will respond within one business day.
